_comment: The exact portable Blender that Lumi bundles. setup/setup.ps1 Step-Blender downloads this zip, verifies its
SHA256 and flattens its single top folder into <root>\.aura\blender, so .aura\blender\blender.exe exists
The hash is the official one published by blender.org; it was read from the checksums file below and the file
size from the zip's Content-Length on 2026-10-05.
Never change version/url without also re-reading the matching line of the .sha256 file from download.blender.org.
Blender is GNU GPL v3 or later: COPYING-GPL-3.0.txt and BLENDER-SOURCE.txt in this folder are installed next to it.
name: Blender
